$comment: Project harness settings — versioned. Personal overrides go in .claude/settings.local.json (gitignored).

permissions.$comment-deny: The real env files are enumerated rather than matched with `.env.*`, so that `.env.example` stays readable. It carries no secrets by design, AGENTS.md names it as the one env file agents may edit, and protect-paths.mjs already exempts it from the write guard — the blanket glob contradicted both and blocked documenting a new variable.
